known_limits: The cargo test step of the local gate skips on a cross-branch push; quorum.yml on the PR head is the check that runs it.
Untracking .pmat/ means the TDG pre-commit hook re-derives its baseline on a fresh clone; the hook's regression check compares against the on-disk baseline, which is now a local artefact.
